heading: Saturday, September 27, 2025
topLine: GPT-5 suggests key step in Aaronson–Witteveen quantum complexity proof.

items.headline: GPT-5 suggests key step in Aaronson–Witteveen quantum complexity proof
items.summary: Scott Aaronson and Freek Witteveen proved that black-box amplification of QMA completeness to doubly-exponentially close to 1 is optimal (arXiv, 25 Sept 2025). On his blog, Aaronson wrote that GPT-5-Thinking suggested the key technical idea: studying the trace of (I − E(θ))⁻¹. The model's first answers were wrong, and the authors checked the idea and wrote the proof themselves. A blog commenter later proposed a simpler function, and Aaronson said the idea arguably should have been obvious to the authors. The preprint has not been peer-reviewed.
